proposed3dDecision.rationale: Detailed mesh control, multi-view inputs, PBR outputs and broad transfer formats make Rodin the first candidate for solid assets. Additional enhancement controls can introduce artifacts and require a targeted reason. No actual superiority over alternatives was measured.
proposed3dDecision.maximumProviderCapabilities: Direct Rodin and Meshy texture ceilings are reported separately from the fal schemas; unavailable fal fields must not be silently submitted.

categoryStrategy.solidProps: AI-assisted3D suitable for rocks, logs, solid cabin modules, vehicle shells, signs and camp props after topology/scale review
categoryStrategy.bridgeAndTower: Generate reference designs and substantial modules; author thin railings, stairs, supports and full spanning structures deterministically to guarantee connectivity and dimensions
categoryStrategy.foliage: Generated images useful for art direction; prefer procedural/species-correct meshes or verified permissive source vegetation with instancing, wind, alpha masks and measured canopy envelopes. A pretty whole-tree mesh does not guarantee needle geometry or sensor occlusion.
categoryStrategy.water: Use Unreal water geometry/materials with physical depth, roughness, reflection/refraction and correct sensor rendering; a generated opaque water-object mesh is not a water system.
categoryStrategy.groundAndTrails: Use tileable PBR material pipeline and terrain paint; image-to-3D soil slabs would introduce seams and poor scale.
categoryStrategy.runtime: Preserve detail in source master, then generate measured runtime meshes/collision/LODs/Nanite variants. High polygon/texture maxima are not target budgets for every repeated object.

licensing.falCompetitionClause: Section14 restricts outputs used to develop/improve products or services competing with third-party models, including training/fine-tuning AI. It is not an explicit blanket ban on SAR detector inference or evaluation.
licensing.sarInference: No explicit detector-inference prohibition found in inspected fal, Rodin or Meshy text. This supports continued image concept work; it is not a blanket statement that unrestricted synthetic-training rights exist.
licensing.meshCompetitiveAI: Meshy specifically prohibits generated assets training/developing/improving AI competitive with Meshy and competitive analysis. Inference testing in the SAR simulation is a different use; provider comparisons require care.
licensing.rodinOutput: Hyper3D §5(b) says it will not limit Rodin output use subject to agreement/law/third-party restrictions. This is contractual permission, not CC0 or MIT.
licensing.apiPrivacy: fal API supplemental terms exclude Pending Enterprise Ready models from no-training promise; Rodin metadata ready versus inspected Meshy/Hunyuan pending. Public original prop references contain no person/scenario truth.
licensing.unresolved: Tripo direct terms 403; Hunyuan partner terms not resolved. No unconditional rights clearance asserted for either.
